effective_date_basis: A stated effective date in the order, if any, over the signature date. A transfer date qualified by 'or as promptly thereafter as practicable' (the exemplar), or a partial transfer left to an official's discretion, is not a delivery date: the end is the delivery or accession record, otherwise a stated gap.
ending_pattern: The order transfers specified property from one agency to another. It is spent on delivery; custody thereafter rests on the transfer, an accrued effect.

exceptions_savings.assessment: The receiving agency's custody is an accrued effect (state transferred_or_accrued).

legal_effect: Research pattern only. A type rule never fills a judgment field, establishes an end, a date, a status or savings for any order, and never substitutes for reading the order's own text.
outlier_conditions: The order's own text (not only the WPA summary or APP title) does not match the type, or the held text is another order's.
The order does more than the type's single act (a second operative clause of another kind).
A later order or statute amends, extends, revokes or revives it before the candidate end.
The order states its own effective date, duration, condition or termination that differs from the pattern.
The order also transfers functions, offices or personnel (organization type).
Transfers 'for temporary use', with reversion or 'for the duration' terms: the property returns, so the order is not spent on delivery.
Vessels later re-transferred or sold: a chain of instruments is needed.
The transfer date is qualified ('or as promptly thereafter as practicable') or the extent of the transfer is left to an official's discretion: the stated date is not the delivery date.
quoted_clause: The historical archives in the Department of State, known as the Revolutionary archives, and comprising (1) the records and papers of the Continental Congress; (2) the papers of George Washington; (3) the papers of James Madison; (4) the papers of Thomas Jefferson; (5) the papers of Alexander Hamilton; (6) the papers of James Monroe; (7) the papers of Benjamin Franklin; are by authority provided by the Act of Congress, entitled "An Act making appropriations for the legislative, executive, and judicial expenses of the government for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1904, and for other purposes," approved February 25, 1903, hereby ordered to be transferred from the Department of State with such exceptions and reservations in each collection herein enumerated as in the discretion of the Secretary of State may be required for the continuity and completeness of the records and archives of the Department of State—to the possession and custody of the Library of Congress, to be there preserved and rendered accessible for historical and other legitimate uses under such rules and regulations as may from time to time be prescribed by the Librarian of Congress.
quoted_parts: The historical archives in the Department of State, known as the Revolutionary archives, and comprising (1) the records and papers of the Continental Congress; (2) the papers of George Washington; (3) the papers of James Madison; (4) the papers of Thomas Jefferson; (5) the papers of Alexander Hamilton; (6) the papers of James Monroe; (7) the papers of Benjamin Franklin; are by authority provided by the Act of Congress, entitled "An Act making appropriations for the legislative, executive, and judicial expenses of the government for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1904, and for other purposes," approved February 25, 1903, hereby ordered to be transferred from the Department of State with such exceptions and reservations in each collection herein enumerated as in the discretion of the Secretary of State may be required for the continuity and completeness of the records and archives of the Department of State—to the possession and custody of the Library of Congress, to be there preserved and rendered accessible for historical and other legitimate uses under such rules and regulations as may from time to time be prescribed by the Librarian of Congress.
The transfer here directed shall be made on the 1st day of July, 1903, or as promptly thereafter as shall be found conveniently practicable to the Department of State and the Library of Congress.
required_evidence: The order's text naming the property and agencies.
The delivery or accession record (agency or receiving-institution record) with its date, or an explicit gap.

scope.note: Membership is a machine lead; each order is decided by an agent, row by row.

source.custody_limit: Exemplar text is a held copy graded mirror_transcription; it illustrates the type's wording and is not an authenticated original.
